_readme: Runtime overrides are picked up from the pack without a code release. Empty means 'use what was compiled in' — this file exists for the day something external moves: a retired tileset or a dead mirror. basemaps: per-style partial overrides keyed dark/light/streets, each {url?, labelsUrl?, attribution?, maxNativeZoom?, subdomains?}. rescues: a full replacement for the tile rescue ladder, each {url, attribution, maxNativeZoom, subdomains?} (labels are always baked into rescue tiles). eventsMirror: URL of an events.json fallback host, overriding the built-in one. accountHost: optional host for the sign-in endpoints; null means same-origin. packHost: optional host for the pack; null means beside the app.
